data.notes: The report gets the core finding right. It challenges "decided before we got in the room" and "nothing to do" with the coverage facts: 9-10 months without a business review, no contact with Stefan, and an analysis that landed three weeks late. It also ties "What's mine?" to clear messaging changes in the customer's own numbers and keeps Adyen's results unknown. It falls short on the tag and the close. It leads with "Value proof" and gives the key's Approval rates tag only as runner_up. Its follow-ups leave out acting on the analysis findings to protect the US volume and set up a win-back. The local-acquiring counter is only partly developed, and the competitor section's "within days" promise contradicts the report's own warning about turnaround. It also names Brazil and Europe in the gaps insight without noting that the markets are unverified.
